title: Fence done-law discriminates by done-flip ancestry, not remote recency

events.justification: The runnable pin for this battery is recorded RED on wave2-task-binding (both --self-test commands, exit 1 + digests, re-run GREEN at its done gate); this follow-up only changes the fence's done-work discriminator to done-flip ancestry after the origin-recency design bricked the wave's own tail commit at push time. The change is pinned by the four citation-seam self-test cases and exercised live by this wave's own push.
